readings: Considering only race results where the starting grid position (`grid`) is 12 or higher: for each driver, add up their points and average their laps completed (`laps`), ignoring missing values. Then, across all those drivers, what are the average points total and the average of their average laps, in one row and unrounded?
queries:
WITH driver_stats AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    SUM(points) AS points_total,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(laps) NOT IN ('', 'N')
      THEN CAST(laps AS REAL)
    END) AS average_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid >= 12
  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
  AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total,
  AVG(average_laps) AS average_laps
FROM driver_stats
